groups.defect: The blank-host example passes because the topic has no embed, so it no longer tests the condition its description claims.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same misleading, vacuous example and explain the same missing setup.

groups.defect: Host lookup normalizes case only on the database side and excludes ports even though stored hosts may include them.
groups.rationale: s_4b5af67b explicitly reports both defects, linking the case-normalization report to the port-matching report.

groups.defect: The migration indexes potentially empty results for both the embed-category lookup and the uncategorized-category fallback.
groups.rationale: All three report the initial lookup crash; the first two additionally report the identical hazard in the fallback. Both lookup sites must be covered.

groups.defect: Both update and destroy dereference a missing EmbeddableHost instead of returning a not-found response.
groups.rationale: Both reports describe the same stale-ID failure in the same two actions, each of which needs safe record lookup.

groups.defect: The context misspells 'embeddable' and misleadingly fabricates a host that the tested method never reads.
groups.rationale: Both report the context-name typo. s_c864cfd5 additionally reports the inert fixture and misleading context, which must survive consolidation.

groups.defect: Plural relationship hydration leaks undefined entries, unconditionally removes original ID attributes despite failed hydration, and crashes on null ID arrays.
groups.rationale: Both report undefined entries from unsuccessful lookups. Their additional reports about attribute replacement and null input form an overlapping group.

groups.defect: The category and embeddable-host fabricator files contain each other's definitions.
groups.rationale: Both describe exactly the same file-content swap and request the same correction.

groups.defect: The normalization callback calls sub! on a nil host, raising an exception instead of producing a validation error.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same unguarded callback and missing-host trigger.
